Project description
On behalf of our client, a retail group with more than 300 stores in the DACH region, we are looking for an experienced Finance Transformation Lead for their SAP S/4HANA programme. The client is redesigning its finance target operating model in parallel.

Tasks
- Business lead for the finance stream of the S/4HANA programme
- Design of R2R, P2P and controlling processes
- Change management and communication for approx. 180 users in finance
- KPI reporting for CFO and steering committee
- Steering of implementation partners

Profile
- Extensive finance background (controlling / accounting), 10 years or more
- At least two finance transformation or ERP implementation projects
- C-level stakeholder management
- Classic and agile project management
- English and German fluent
- Retail experience and Power BI / SAC are a plus

Two days per week on-site in Munich are required.
